scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem concerns unweighted frequency subsets of cyclic prime-power groups with counting inner product. It gives the exact minimum tight-frame cardinality and one explicit optimizer, but does not classify all minimizers, all larger admissible cardinalities, or general composite cyclic groups. Exact finite computation is used only as a replay check; the universal claim is proved analytically by a Gram-matrix criterion and cyclotomic divisibility.
title: Minimum tight exponential-frame size on cyclic prime-power groups
